derivedFiles.change: Updated only the files allowlist to include derived modules, LICENSE and SOURCE.json; removed the absent README entry. Version, main and exports are unchanged.

localDerivation.stateLifecycle: Existing process/module caches remain declared exactly once in their domain modules, not recreated per plugin or request. Retained Run and segment state stays on the original owner instances; per-Run accounting/decoder/transport closures stay together. Pool and wire dependencies remain injected through the original constructor.
wiringChanges: Added static ESM imports/exports and MIT/SOURCE attribution comments; no eval, new Function, vm or textual runtime loading.
Moved the existing _internal resetH1/onH1 and resetTeam/expireTeam closure bodies to their state-owning modules; the regional retry invokes resetH1() instead of assigning a cross-file primitive copy.
All internal imports stay within this Cursor directory or Node built-ins; the module dependency graph is acyclic.
localDerivation.clientToolIsolation: Both Run paths retain x-cursor-agent-allowed-tools=mcp_tool_call,get_mcp_tools_tool_call. The original exec bridge still refuses Cursor shell/file/edit requests and foreign, unregistered or approval-based native MCP calls.
localDerivation.license: MIT; original LICENSE preserved without modification

securityDerivations.scope: Cursor vendor upstream destinations only; not user-selected egress proxy URLs

changes.change: Validate configured, cached and default Agent URLs as absolute HTTPS URLs on cursor.sh/cursor.com or their dot-delimited subdomains. Reject userinfo (including empty @), fragments (including empty #), whitespace/backslashes, malformed URLs/DNS labels, non-default ports and noncanonical port syntax. Return the validated canonical URL; only omitted port or literal :443 is accepted. Validation stays outside the configuration fetch fallback catch, and the old cache entry is removed before validating a newly advertised endpoint.

Surface only CURSOR_ENDPOINT_REJECTED NativeSessionError as the existing HTTP 502 cursor_error response with X-Magpie-Sign-In: kept, covering both initial selection and regional refresh. Do not change handling of other native-session errors.

Set redirect: error on all fetch routes carrying the account bearer token or API key, so a server-provided HTTP Location cannot choose another authenticated upstream destination. Grok Bot's Cookie request already has redirect: error and remains unchanged; auth/poll carries no bearer/key and is unchanged.

samePackageReview.serverSelectedEndpoint: Only agentUrlConfig.agentUrl/agentnUrl feeds a dynamic authenticated destination, via agentURL -> runNative/runOnce -> open/openH2 -> HTTP/2 Authorization; both initial selection and regional refresh share validation.
samePackageReview.fixedAuthenticatedRoutes: Dashboard/model/account unary calls, API-key exchange, usage-event queries, GetHardLimit, GetCurrentPeriodUsage, RunSSE and BidiAppend use the pinned HTTPS API constant; Grok Bot uses the pinned HTTPS WEBSITE constant. HTTP/2 does not follow redirects, and authenticated fetch calls now reject redirects.
samePackageReview.nonDestinationURLs: The loader input URL only selects /chat/completions and is not fetched upstream. Browser login uses the fixed WEBSITE constant. History images are embedded data or text and are never fetched with account credentials. No other server-returned body URL routes to an authenticated request.

securityDerivations.errorBehavior: The first present agentUrl/agentnUrl candidate is validated in the original priority order. An invalid selected candidate throws HTTP 502 CURSOR_ENDPOINT_REJECTED before opening that endpoint; the response names the field and rejection reason but never echoes the URL, userinfo or token. No second candidate, default-host fallback or regional/Max Mode retry is used after rejection. Missing endpoint fields or a failed config fetch keep the existing validated default-AGENT fallback and cache TTL; valid configured endpoints retain their existing priority and caching.
securityDerivations.unchanged: All public exports, MIT LICENSE, limits/session/pool/usage-debt ownership, client-tool isolation, transport FIFO, heartbeat, timeout and HTTP/2 fallback logic remain intact. No main/network, host, Rust, build configuration, UI or other provider changes; no egress-proxy allowlist.
securityDerivations.verification: Pinned local reference source and same-package callsite review; pure Bun bundling only, with no plugin execution, tests, accounts or upstream requests.

securityDerivations.kind: Shared caller-MCP authorization for retained and stateless Cursor Runs
securityDerivations.change: Extracted the existing native-path caller authorization into callerMcpAllowed and apply it before publishing or answering any MCP exec envelope in both native=true and native=false paths. Require any supplied provider/server namespace to be tools or legacy magpie, the resolved tool name to be in caller tools, no approval field 6 or nonzero approval field 7, and a namespaced field-1 name when explicit field 5 is absent. Every repeated envelope is checked before the selected call can be returned.
securityDerivations.toolChoice: The unchanged conversation.mjs toolsOf returns no tools for omitted/empty declarations or tool_choice:none and filters a named choice; both exec paths now enforce that resulting caller list.
securityDerivations.denialBehavior: Foreign, unregistered, disabled or approval-requiring MCP requests use the existing upstream not available ExecClientControlMessage followed by exec close and return null. No client toolcall is emitted or executed. Rejections still count as bridge-answered calls in the original decoder/native owner batch and usage paths; a naturally unknown model tool is a refused call, not a claimed local RCE.
securityDerivations.unchanged: Valid native-call shape, native strict protobuf/MCP decoding, duplicate identity validation, native/stateless argument encoding, IDs, actual execution boundary, client-owned execution, limits, pool/session/usage-debt state and all public exports are unchanged.
securityDerivations.verification: Static source diff and pure Bun bundling only; no CLI, plugin execution, tests, accounts or requests.
